questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Unfeigned
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Pretended**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Unfeigned **means devoid of any hypocrisy or pretense: genuine. (किसी भी पाखंड या ढोंग से रहित: वास्तविक)

 
 
• Example -* If you greet a friend with **unfeigned **joy, she'll know you are happy to see her.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Pretended **means to behave in a particular way in order to make other people believe something that is not true. (प्रदर्शन, ढोंग या दिखावा करना)
 
 
• Example -* His **pretended **wealth was proved to be nonexistent.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that '**Unfeigned**' and '**Pretended**' are opposite in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 3.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Sincere **means not pretending or lying; honest. (ढोंग या झूठ नहीं बोलना: ईमानदार)
 
• **Genuine **means sincere and honest; that can be trusted. (सच्‍चा और ईमानदार; विश्‍वास के योग्‍य)
 
• **Expressive **means showing feelings or thoughts. (भावभरा, भावाभिव्‍यंजक)

questions.question:
**Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

A living organism that steals nourishment from other living beings
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Parasite**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**parasite**' can substitute the given group of words.
 
• '**Parasite**' is a noun that refers to an organism that lives on or in another organism and benefits by deriving nutrients at the host's expense. ('परजीवी' एक संज्ञा है जो एक ऐसे जीव को संदर्भित करती है जो किसी अन्य जीव पर या उसमें रहता है और मेजबान के खर्च पर पोषक तत्व प्राप्त करके लाभ उठाता है)
 
• The word 'parasite' can also be used metaphorically to refer to a person who habitually relies on or exploits others and gives nothing in return.
 
• The word 'parasite' is derived from the Greek word '**parasitos**', which means 'one who eats at the table of another'.

Therefore, **option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Vector**: A vector is an organism that carries and transmits infectious pathogens into another living organism. (वेक्टर एक ऐसा जीव है जो संक्रामक रोगज़नक़ों को दूसरे जीवित जीव में ले जाता है और प्रसारित करता है)
 
• **Insect**: An insect is a small arthropod animal with six legs and a body divided into three parts. (कीट एक छोटा आर्थ्रोपॉड जानवर है जिसके छह पैर होते हैं और शरीर तीन भागों में विभाजित होता है)
 
• **Co-Dependent**: Co-dependency is a psychological condition in which a person is excessively reliant on another person for emotional or physical support. (सह-निर्भरता एक मनोवैज्ञानिक स्थिति है जिसमें एक व्यक्ति भावनात्मक या शारीरिक समर्थन के लिए दूसरे व्यक्ति पर अत्यधिक निर्भर होता है)

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Drastic times call for drastic measures

options.text: When you are extremely desperate you need to take extremely desperate actions
Don't rely on it until you sure of it
Something that ends at the last minute or last few seconds
Do not pull all your resources in one possibility

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **When you are extremely desperate you need to take extremely desperate actions**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**drastic times call for drastic measures**" means that in a situation of extreme difficulty or crisis, one must take extreme actions to solve the problem. (अत्यधिक कठिनाई या संकट की स्थिति में, समस्या को हल करने के लिए व्यक्ति को अत्यधिक कार्रवाई करनी चाहिए)

 
 
• **For example- ***When the prolonged recession forced him to shut down his business, Dev decided to sell groceries to make ends meet. Drastic times call for drastic measures!*

 
 
 
 
• The word "**drastic**" means extreme or severe, and "**measures**" refer to actions taken to solve a problem.
 
• This idiom emphasizes the urgency of the situation and the need for immediate action.
 
• It suggests that the usual or conventional methods may not work in such situations, and one needs to be creative and bold in finding a solution.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let us look at the other options.

 
• Option 2: "**Don't rely on it until you sure of it**" is not related to the idiom and is a general advice to be cautious before trusting something or someone.
 
• Option 3: "**Something that ends at the last minute or last few seconds**" is not related to the idiom and describes a situation of last-minute or sudden completion.
 
• Option 4: "**Do not pull all your resources in one possibility**" is not related to the idiom and advises against putting all efforts or resources in one option or possibility.
